snippet.title: Estranged Family - Demo trailer
snippet.description:
Thank you for 1500 downloads for Friendship Test! To celebrate, here is the trailer for Estranged Family’s demo, coming out January 7th (3 days after the 1st anniversary of FT’s demo!)

------

Music credit: 
III by Sylvain Carton
9 by Lily Taylor
    from Song-O-Phone 
(source: Free Music Archive)
Attribution 4.0 International: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Sound effects credit:
Buzzer 4 by floraphonic
Hearbeat by JasperL91 (Freesound) from freesound_community
(source: Pixabay)
